scene_correspondence: The frames support overlapping views of the same furnished room through the table, chair, window-radiator-plant ensemble, landscape picture and wall-side wooden support. A denotes shot1 and B denotes shot3. The table and installed radiator are eligible reference candidates, without asserting a complete room alignment or classifying anomalies.
limitations: All 17 shot1 and 21 shot3 entities are included exactly once. Coordinates and scales are independent monocular estimates; neither raw coordinate equality nor reprojection IoU establishes cross-shot position or depth. Repeated frames have correlated predictions. Cropping, person occlusion, uncertain furniture extents and aggregate detections limit correspondence. Unmatched means no corresponding frozen node, not demonstrated physical absence. Anchor eligibility does not certify immobility or a unique orientation.
